040    // private val unused, but placed to force java tostring to include the formatted alerts set
041    private Set<AlertResponseType> alerts;
042
043    public AlertStatusResponse() {}
044
045    public AlertStatusResponse(BigInteger intMap) {
046        this.cargo = buildCargo(intMap);
047        parse(cargo);
048    }
049
050    public AlertStatusResponse(byte[] raw) {
051        parse(raw);
052    }
053
054    private static byte[] buildCargo(BigInteger byte0uint64) {
055        return Bytes.toUint64(byte0uint64.longValue());
056    }
057
058    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
059        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == props().size());
060        intMap = Bytes.readUint64(raw, 0);
061        cargo = raw;
062        alerts = getAlerts();
063    }
064
065    public BigInteger getIntMap() {
066        return intMap;
067    }
068    public long getBitMap() {
069        return intMap.longValue();
070    }

074    public int size() {
075        return alerts==null ? 0 : alerts.size();
076    }

210        private final int bitmask;
211        private final String description;
212        AlertResponseType(int bitmask) {
213            this.bitmask = bitmask;
214            this.description = null;
215        }
216
217        AlertResponseType(int bitmask, String description) {
218            this.bitmask = bitmask;
219            this.description = description;
220        }
221
222        public int bitmask() {
223            return bitmask;
224        }
225
226        public int getId() {
227            return bitmask;
228        }
229
230        public String getDescription() {
231            return description;
232        }
233
234        public boolean isKnown() {
235            return description != null && !description.isBlank();
236        }
237
238        public String toString() {
239            return name();
240        }
241
242        public BigInteger withBit() {
243            return BigInteger.ZERO.setBit(bitmask);
244        }
245
246        public static AlertResponseType fromSingularId(long id) {
247            for (AlertResponseType type : values()) {
248                if (type.bitmask == id) {
249                    return type;
250                }
251            }
252            return null;
253        }
254    }
255
256    public Set<AlertResponseType> getAlerts() {
257        Set<AlertResponseType> current = new TreeSet<>();
258        for (AlertResponseType type : AlertResponseType.values()) {
259            if (intMap.testBit(type.bitmask())) {
260                current.add(type);
261            }
262        }
263
264        return current;
265    }
266
267    @Override
268    public Set<Integer> notificationIds() {
269        Set<Integer> ids = new HashSet<>();
270
271        for (AlertResponseType alert : getAlerts()) {
272            if (alert.isKnown()) {
273                ids.add(alert.getId());
274            }
275        }
276
277        return ids;
278    }
